    "noeol.txt": "alpha\nbeta",
    "empty.txt": "",
    "unicode.txt": "one\x0btwo\nthree\x0cfour\nfive\x1csix\nseven\u2028eight\nnine\n",
    "meta.txt": "a.b\naxb\n[c]\n\nlast\n",
    "crlf.txt": "foo\r\nbar\r\nbaz",
}
paths = []
for name, text in files.items():
    p = os.path.join(d, name)
    with open(p, "w", newline="") as f:
        f.write(text)
    paths.append(p)

cases = []
for pat in ["alpha", "beta", "a.b", "two", "four", "six", "eight", "", "foo", "zzz"]:
    for flags in ["", "-n", "-i", "-v", "-x", "-n -i", "-x -v", "-l", "-n -l"]:
        cases.append((pat, flags, paths))

fails = 0
for pat, flags, fs in cases:
    args = ["grep"] + flags.split() + ["--", pat] + fs
    expected = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    got = grep(pat, flags, fs)
    if got != expected:
        fails += 1
        print("MISMATCH pat=%r flags=%r" % (pat, flags))
        print(" expected:", repr(expected[:300]))
        print(" got     :", repr(got[:300]))
print("cases:", len(cases), "failures:", fails)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/exercise")
from grep import grep

# Simulate the test harness's StringIO patching
import io, unittest.mock as mock

FILE_TEXT = {
    "noeol.txt": "alpha\nbeta",
    "empty.txt": "",
    "sep.txt": "one\x0btwo\nthree\x0cfour\nfive\x1csix\nseven\u2028eight\nnine\n",
    "blank.txt": "a\n\nb\n",
}
def open_mock(fname, *a, **k):
    return io.StringIO(FILE_TEXT[fname])

checks = [
    # newline-only splitting: \x0b etc must NOT break lines
    ("beta", "", ["noeol.txt"], "beta\n"),
    ("one\x0btwo", "", ["noeol.txt", "sep.txt"], "sep.txt:one\x0btwo\n"),
    ("two", "-n", ["sep.txt"], "1:one\x0btwo\n"),
    # empty file contributes nothing, even inverted
    ("x", "-v", ["empty.txt"], ""),
    # trailing newline does not create a phantom final empty line
    ("^$", "", [], ""),
    ("", "-x", ["blank.txt"], "\n"),
    ("", "-n", ["blank.txt"], "1:a\n2:\n3:b\n"),
    ("", "-l", ["blank.txt", "empty.txt"], "blank.txt\n"),
    # empty pattern with -v matches nothing
    ("", "-v", ["blank.txt"], ""),
    # -l takes precedence over -n; one name per matching file, file order kept
    ("a", "-n -l", ["noeol.txt", "blank.txt", "empty.txt"], "noeol.txt\nblank.txt\n"),
    ("zzz", "-l", ["noeol.txt", "blank.txt"], ""),
    ("a", "-x", ["noeol.txt"], ""),
    ("beta", "-x", ["noeol.txt"], "beta\n"),
]
fails = 0
with mock.patch("grep.open", side_effect=open_mock, create=True):
    for pat, flags, fs, exp in checks:
        if not fs:
            continue
        got = grep(pat, flags, fs)
        if got != exp:
            fails += 1
            print("FAIL pat=%r flags=%r -> %r expected %r" % (pat, flags, got, exp))
print("sanity checks:", len(checks) - 1, "failures:", fails)
